richiami.difetto: It has been identified that weak welding in the upper section of some vertical tubes in the rear seat frame is present in subject vehicles. This may lead in cases of impact to the seat belt becoming insecure.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the mechanical strength of the seat frame weak points improved by the fitting of a retrofit kit.
